concerns: The entry for 幼少期 has a reading of {幼少期|ようしょうき} (ようしょうき). However, the example for 幼少期 in pair 3 is {幼少期|ようしょ}, which is a partial reading and inconsistent with the full reading provided in the entry. While partial readings are allowed, this specific partial reading is incorrect because it cuts off in the middle of a mora (しょう). It should be {幼少期|ようしょうき} or {幼少|ようしょう} followed by {期|き}.
